prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but to give you a short, reliable list of specific orthodontists to call I need one quick detail: which part of Miami are you in (or your ZIP code)? Also helpful: are you an adult or a child/teen, do you prefer Invisalign over braces, and do you have insurance or a budget range?

While you reply, here’s practical guidance so your calls get the right info:

What to ask when you call
- Are you a board-certified orthodontist? (orthodontic specialty training after dental school)
- Do you treat adults/teens/children and have experience with cases like mine?
- Do you provide Invisalign (or clear aligners) and traditional braces? Which do you recommend for my situation?
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year? (experienced providers get better results)
- Do you use digital 3D scanning (iTero) and digital treatment planning?
- What’s the expected length and total cost (including retainers)? Do you offer a written estimate?
- Do you accept my insurance; what in-network options/discounts/HSAs do you take?
- Do you offer payment plans, in-house financing, or third-party options?
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and read patient reviews?
- Do you offer a free or low-cost initial consult? Will X-rays be taken at that visit?
- Emergency policy and office hours (same-day for broken braces/wires?)
- Languages spoken by staff (if important)

Where I can help next
- If you give me your neighborhood or ZIP, age, and Invisalign vs braces preference (and insurance), I’ll assemble a short list of 4–6 specific Miami orthodontists/clinics with phone numbers, addresses, quick reasons to call each, and what to ask them based on your needs.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
